label: copy phase: fed-back u that was the 2nd-4th original token
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase, when the fed-back input is the letter u (essentially 100% of activation mass is on in_tok u). That is, the model just re-emitted u as original token 1-3 (recall_idx 2-4). Magnitude falls with position: largest (~0.95-1.0 of max) when u was orig(1) (prev2 = <DEL>), around 0.55-0.6 when u was orig(2), and about 0.2-0.4 when u was orig(3). Weak or absent for u as orig(0), negligible beyond orig(3), and it does not fire when u is the last copy input (to_go 0). Never fires on u in the original phase, at the delimiter, or on any other token. Remaining false positives are mostly u at recall_idx 4.

issues: The predicate holds up. I reproduced test P 0.905 / R 0.985 / F1 0.943 / mass recall 0.999. in_tok u carries 100% of the activation mass, and nothing fires in the original phase or at the delimiter. Missed activations are 552 steps holding 0.1% of the mass, all tiny (u as orig(0), or u at recall_idx 5 or later).

Per recall_idx on dev (u, to_go>=1): r1 P 0.02, r2 P 0.986, r3 P 0.998, r4 P 0.657, r5 P 0.016. With to_go==0, P is 0.002. The claims 'weak/absent for orig(0)', 'does not fire at to_go 0' and 'most FPs are recall_idx 4' all check out.

The magnitude claim is wrong. The explanation says activation is about 0.95-1.0 of max whenever u was orig(1). In fact magnitude depends strongly on L / to_go, not just on recall position. Coverage by activation quartile for u at r2: L=4 (to_go 1) falls entirely in the bottom two quartiles [0.18, 0.06, 0, 0] with P 0.91. L=5 is mostly in the middle quartiles. Only L>=7 sits mainly in the top quartile. The profile examples agree: 'j u x c i' (L=5) r2 = 0.56, and '1 u j u r t' r2 = 0.67. By to_go, to_go=1 holds 6.4% of the mass versus about 20% at to_go 3-5.

The recall_idx-4 false positives are also tied to L. r4 precision: L=6 (to_go 1) 0.44, L=7-9 about 0.69-0.77, and L=5 (to_go 0) about 0. They look like the same graded effect falling below threshold, not a separate token or history class. Dropping to_go 1 at r4 barely helps: test F1 0.9453 vs 0.9434.
The label is fine as a firing condition, but it leaves out that strength grows with sequence length / outputs remaining.
